events.content:
Implemented a server-rendered product catalog page with a regular HTML form wired to an inline Server Action in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:4). The action calls `revalidateTag` with the shared `"products"` tag and the `"max"` profile, allowing stale catalog data to be served while Next.js refreshes it in the background.

The product reader in [lib/db.js](/workspace/lib/db.js:1) is cached with that same tag, so views using the shared reader can refresh from the same catalog cache. I also added the catalog layout and styling, and updated the page metadata.

The repository’s product reader is still a mock database query; the action invalidates its cache but does not connect to an ERP/PIM sync service. I did not run tests or a build.
